name: Turritopsis
source:
Following Oliver, a trans man attempting to socially transition. The theme of this jam was rebirth, so I decided to make it a metaphorical rebirth in that he's transitioning to become what he should be. You have two stats to keep track of: your mental health and your reputation. If either one of these gets low, it affects the other option. If both of them get to 0, you get a bad ending. You determine these stats by making choices throughout the game, and the bars will vary depending on your choice. 

[From [url=https://hexmozart88.itch.io/turritopsis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕跨性别男性Oliver展开，讲述他尝试在社会层面完成性别转换的经历。这次创作活动的主题是“重生”，所以我决定把他转变为真实自我的过程写成一次象征性的重生。你需要追踪两项数值：心理健康与声誉。任何一项降低，都会影响另一项；若两项都降至0，就会迎来坏结局。你通过游戏中的选择决定数值变化，状态条也会随选择而增减。

[来源：[url=https://hexmozart88.itch.io/turritopsis]Itch.io[/url]]
